derivation: apply Subtype.ext; exact GeneralLinearGroup.ext (fun i j => by simpa only [← g.2.diagonal_diag, ← h.2.diagonal_diag] using congrArg (fun d => Matrix.diagonal d i j) (funext heq))
explanation: `Matrix.IsDiag.diagonal_diag` reconstructs a diagonal matrix from its diagonal entries. Apply it to the underlying matrices of `g` and `h`; their diagonal functions agree by `funext heq`, so the matrices, and hence the subtype elements, are equal. The existing proof instead establishes equality entrywise using `GeneralLinearGroup.ext`.
